messages:
jules: Noticed reconciliation deltas for EU customers after the timezone cutover this weekend. Midnight cutoff appears shifted by +1h for some accounts.

patrick: Can you share logs/example customer? Is this on the Stripe side or our NetSuite mapper?

jules: Example log: ```2026-10-31T00:59:59+01:00 ERROR billing-window: customer=cus_EU01 computed_cutoff=2026-10-31T01:00:00+01:00 expected_cutoff=2026-10-31T00:00:00+00:00```

jules: We did a region cutover for Europe on DST end; looks like some services used local midnight and others used UTC midnight when computing billing_window.

ina: That could cause events with billable_ts between 00:00-01:00 UTC to be attributed to the wrong day depending on which service computed the window. How many customers affected?

jules: Quick scan: 14 customers had misattributed usage lines; 6 invoices already posted. Exported details to internal sheet (private).

leo_fin: Finance exposure? Any high-value accounts? We need to hold on auto-notify until we confirm fix.

jules: Two enterprise accounts impacted (small amounts), three SMB invoices needed memo adjustments. Total gross exposure ~ $3.2k.

patrick: Root cause hypothesis: webhook consumer stores billable_ts without timezone normalization, later the nightly aggregator floor_to_day uses server-local timezone during cutover. Patch plan: canonicalize all billable_ts to UTC on ingress and make aggregator use UTC windows. Also add a compensating backfill to reassign misattributed events.

ina: Agree. Also add a guard in NetSuite mapper: if incoming item's billable_ts is more than 2 hours away from invoice period, flag for manual review instead of auto-post.

ops-bot: nightly-summary 2026-10-31T04:05:00Z - batches=388 events=2,880 failed=2 dlq=3 timezone-mismatch-alert=14

patrick: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/fin-inc/pull/702 "billing: normalize billable_ts to UTC and use UTC windows". Includes unit tests for DST transition scenarios. Assigning @ina for review.

ina: Reviewing. Small nit: add explicit test for historical events replay (older events should keep original UTC assignment).

ci-bot: Pipeline for PR 702 passed at 2026-10-31T07:12:08Z. unit=ok integration=ok smoke=ok

patrick: Deployed to staging 2026-10-31T07:45Z. Running staging backfill dry-run: `./tools/tz_backfill --since 2026-10-30 --until 2026-10-31 --dry-run --only-eu`

jules: Dry-run shows 14 adjustments and no duplicate credits. Pushed CSV to the PR for finance validation.

leo_fin: Finance validated dry-run output. Please schedule live backfill and tag the enterprise accounts so sales can prepare a note if needed. Hold on public notifications until I draft message.

patrick: Live backfill scheduled 2026-11-01T01:00Z. Command executed. Backfill summary: reconciled=14 duplicates=0 manual_review=4. Two invoices needed small memo adjustments.

ops-bot: backfill-job 2026-11-01T01:22:40Z - reconciled=14 manual_flags=4

nina: Merged PR and added Datadog alert `billing.tz_mismatch_count > 1 for 10m` to catch regressions. Also updated docs: billing cutoffs always computed in UTC.

leo_fin: Final: finance will absorb small memo adjustments and notify enterprise sales to proactively reach out if customers ask. Closing loop; filing FIN-912 to add DST test to nightly integration suite.

jules: Thanks team. Putting a short postmortem note in FIN-912 and adding replay tests for CET/CEST transitions. :white_check_mark:
